title: puya mirabilis
intro: Puya mirabilis, commonly known as the Puna Onion or the Red Onion, is a type of flowering plant that belongs to the family Asphodelaceae. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties and is used to treat various health conditions, including respiratory issues, such as bronchitis and asthma, due to its expectorant properties, which help in relieving cough and congestion. The bioactive constituents present in Puya mirabilis include alkaloids, flavonoids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its therapeutic actions, including anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant effects. The health benefits of Puya mirabilis include the ability to reduce inflammation, fight off infections, and protect against oxidative stress, making it a valuable plant in traditional medicine.
